assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original editorial cover photograph for a small-home garden magazine article about planning winter furniture storage. Landscape 3:2. Modest American ground-level courtyard patio in late October: pale stone paving, cream stucco wall, open doorway to a bright interior in background, two simple sage-green powder-coated metal bistro chairs and a small round metal table, no cushions on chairs. On the table a neatly folded taupe outdoor furniture cover and a plain closed notebook, all dry. A few copper autumn leaves collected neatly near a terracotta planter with seasonal foliage. Keep the whole doorway clear and furniture safely away from it. Cool clear autumn daylight with a gentle warm accent, realistic natural textures and correct chair/table structure, attractive attainable clean modern style. Full chairs and tabletop in frame, no people, no lettering, no brands, no watermark, no snow, no collage, no diagram. This is an illustrative planning scene, not proof of suitability for winter outdoor storage.
